sources.title: ConFIG: Towards Conflict-free Training of Physics Informed Neural Networks
sources.snippet: The loss functions of many learning problems contain multiple additive terms that can disagree and yield conflicting update directions. For Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), loss terms on initial/boundary conditions and physics equations are particularly interesting as they are well-established as highly difficult tasks.
